text: Milk is standardised, heated, evaporated and sweetened, then cooled while lactose crystallisation is induced to keep the texture smooth.

sources.text: The table, the facts and the words on how it is made, from these.

steps.note: Sugar is added, in a ratio of 9 parts sugar to 11 parts evaporated milk.
The milk is cooled while its milk sugar is made to crystallise, which keeps it smooth.
